exposure: history of one prior cesarean delivery
history of two prior cesarean deliveries
cohort: All patients with a history of one or two prior cesarean deliveries who gave birth at term at Goethe University Frankfurt between 2014 and 2021.
finding: There was no significant increase in overall maternal or fetal morbidity in women with two previous cesarean sections compared to one, although the success rate of vaginal delivery was lower and the rate of complete uterine rupture was higher in the group with two prior cesareans.
mod_finding: The success rate of vaginal delivery was lower for women with two prior cesareans (34.2%) compared to one prior cesarean (70.3%), and the rate of complete uterine rupture was higher in patients with two prior cesareans who underwent cesarean section after onset of labor (3.4%) compared to none in the one prior cesarean group.
